messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — code freeze for v2.4.0 goes into effect at 18:00 UTC today. Please avoid feature merges after that time; only critical fixes or docs-only changes. If you need a late merge, fill out the exception form in #release-exceptions and tag me.

Devon: ETA on branch lock?

Maya: Branch lock flips at 18:00 UTC. After that, only cherry-picks to release/2.4 allowed. We'll be strict about regressions.

Liam: I have a tiny docs-only version bump in PR #7890 (updates changelog entry + package.json patch). Can that be fast-tracked?

Maya: Docs-only typically ok, but we need a quick QA thumbs and a green CI run on release branch after cherry-pick. Can you confirm it's docs-only and provide a short checklist?

Liam: Confirmed — no code touched, just changelog and version number. Checklist: 1) lint passes 2) linkcheck 3) staging docs render. CI currently green on my branch.

Devon: If it's truly docs-only, we can approve as an exception. @release-bot can you mark this as docs-exception candidate?

release-bot: auto: Received exception request for PR #7890. Please add label "release/docs-exception" and request an oncall approval.

Liam: Added label and pinged @Devon for oncall approval. Also added the cherry-pick command in the PR description:

```
# cherry-pick into release/2.4
git checkout release/2.4
git pull origin release/2.4
git cherry-pick -x abc1234def
git push origin HEAD:release/2.4
```

Maya: Perfect. Devon — can you give oncall +1 so CI can run the deploy job? We want this merged before the freeze if possible (within the next 30m).

Devon: +1 oncall, looks docs-only. Running a manual linkcheck on staging now.

Ci-bot: CI: build passed for PR #7890 (lint, linkcheck). Flaky gpu tests skipped for docs-only runs.

Maya: Thanks — once cherry-picked, I'll merge the release/2.4 PR and tag. Liam please monitor staging render and post a quick ok.

Liam: Will do — staging render verified, changelog looks good. Please proceed.

Maya: Cherry-pick merged to release/2.4 at 17:46 UTC. Lock will still go in at 18:00 but this is cleared as an exception. Noting here: exception approved by Devon, docs-only, CI green.

Devon: One note for next time — include a one-line reason in the exception form (e.g., "docs clarity for release notes") to speed approvals.

Liam: Good call, will add. Thanks all :tada:
